name: @qf-jarvis/postgres-approval-queue
description: QF Jarvis durable approval queue and audit (QFJ-P08, ADR-0081). PostgreSQL durability for the approval-runtime foundation: it stores the exact ApprovalRequestV1 with a canonical source snapshot, stores Core's ApprovalDecisionV1 verbatim, links one to the other without editing either, and enforces at most ONE active ask per (recommendation, action) -- because ApprovalDecisionV1 deliberately carries no approvalRequestId, so two overlapping asks would make an arriving decision ambiguous. It holds NO status, pending or approved column: a request exists, a decision may exist, a link may exist, and authority lives only in the immutable Core artifact. Every approval semantic is re-proved through the PUBLIC approval runtime rather than reimplemented. No Core call, operator API, consent, execution intent, transport or clock. Depends on @qf-jarvis/contracts, @qf-jarvis/approval-runtime, @qf-jarvis/recommendation-runtime and pg.
